title: SCNet P0 R06f 800 m/s measurement-contract repair recanary
purpose: Re-run only the unchanged 800 m/s, 0.75 mm isolated control after prospectively repairing the output contract: remove unsupported direct-contact requests, explicitly request six D3PART solid history variables, and bind MAT_015 damage to full-D3PLOT HVAR6.

provenance.identity_rule: Mesh, coordinates, connectivity, node/element IDs, PIDs, material, EOS, contact, section, timestep, boundary conditions, impact speed, and termination time remain identical to r06e_0800_ctrl; only database-output cards and prospective contracts change.

symmetry.validity: normal incidence, face-on cube, centered impact only

shared_measurement_upgrade.database_extent_binary_policy: Set NEIPH=6 and explicitly preserve all other R15.0.2 documented Card 1/Card 2 defaults; Card 2 is mandatory.

damage_source.sentinel_policy: absolute value at or above 1e29 is unavailable with a reason, never zero

shared_measurement_upgrade.database_extent_d3part_policy: Explicit NEIPH=6 request is a redundant-channel experiment; full D3PLOT HVAR6 remains authoritative.

paired_experiments.question: Does an unchanged isolated 800 m/s control reproduce Job 72397333 after only the prospective output contract changes?

preregistered_evaluation.primary_comparison: r06f_0800_ctrl versus platform Job 72397333 using the frozen diagnostic q tolerances
preregistered_evaluation.support_condition: Target R15.0.2 parses and terminates normally; required artifacts are readable; qM/qP/qE absolute differences are each <=0.01 and qV relative difference is <=0.05.
preregistered_evaluation.refute_condition: Parser/runtime failure, missing required output, unexplained non-finite/sentinel data, or any frozen numerical comparison tolerance is exceeded.
preregistered_evaluation.damage_channel_gate: Full D3PLOT HVAR6 must be readable with alive masking. D3PART HVAR6 is informative only and does not block Wave 0 if the authoritative D3PLOT channel is valid.
preregistered_evaluation.claim_boundary: A repeatable recanary does not recover the unavailable primary QoI or establish physical validity.

submission_sequence.wave_0_gate: Zero KEY errors, normal termination, run-integrity PASS, readable D3PART capture ledger, readable full-D3PLOT HVAR6 with alive masking, and frozen repeatability tolerances.
submission_sequence.hold_after_wave_0: Do not submit the TSSFAC=0.4 diagnostic, 2000 m/s control, or any treatment until the returned R06f recanary is audited.
submission_sequence.resource_identity: Use exactly one node, 32 ranks, LS-DYNA R15 MPP double precision, and the same memory settings as Job 72397333.

deferred_not_generated.reason: Generate only after the R06f recanary return is audited; it is the next single-factor numerical diagnostic.
Hold until both the recanary and the TSSFAC=0.4 comparison pass.

claim_boundary: This prospective contract does not rewrite the frozen R06e failure/hold decision.
INTFOR and NCFORC absence is not a zero contact response.
A readable HVAR6 is a solver measurement channel, not evidence that the material law is physically calibrated.
Static PASS and normal termination do not establish numerical repeatability, P0 admission, or dataset-label admission.
Only one R06f 800 m/s control job is generated and exposed in this release.
The targeted canary remains outside the reference response distribution and training labels.
